name: Regex Tester
description: Test regular expressions live: highlight matches, inspect groups and preview replacements, with lookaround and backreferences
help: Matching runs in the local Rust engine (fancy-regex) with lookahead / lookbehind, backreferences and named groups (?P<name>…).
Flags: i ignore case, m multi-line (^ $ per line), s dot matches newline, x ignore whitespace and # comments.
Click a match on the right to locate it; replacements support $0, $1 and ${name}.
Runaway backtracking is stopped automatically so the app never hangs.

replace.title: Replace
replace.label: Replace with
replace.hint: $0 is the whole match, $1 / ${name} are groups, $$ is a literal $

errors.regex.backtrack_limit: Too much backtracking, stopped (simplify nested quantifiers)
